$description: Reco's theme, in the Design Tokens format (W3C DTCG, as Refero exports it). `color` is the dark palette (herding.app's) and `lightColor` the light one (Default's); `role` is what the app uses, each role's `$value` its dark colour (an alias like {color.void} or a hex) and `$extensions.com.reco.theme` its light and Increase Contrast colours (aliases like {lightColor.snow} too). To change themes: replace `color` or `lightColor` with the new palette, point the roles at it (and set their light and high-contrast values), then run `scripts/apply-theme.py`, which writes Reco/Assets.xcassets. Check that every role still meets WCAG AA contrast. `font` and `radius` are read by Typeface.swift and EditorTheme.swift; keep them matching.

off-white-ink.$description: Off-White Ink — Primary text, icon strokes, heading color — slightly cream warm-white reads softer than pure #fff against olive-charcoal surfaces

page-void.$description: Page Void — Deepest page background, behind everything; the recessed layer

graphite-card.$description: Graphite Card — Primary card and surface — most panels, modals, and elevated containers

slate-matte.$description: Slate Matte — Canvas-level surface, outer page background, content area baseline

ash-step.$description: Ash Step — Subtle surface lift, nested card backgrounds, hover wash

stone-lift.$description: Stone Lift — Higher elevation tier, active rows, secondary surface

pewter-button.$description: Pewter Button — Button and chip backgrounds, pressed states

bistre-border.$description: Bistre Border — Dark border stroke, hairline separators, outline button border on hover

fog-text.$description: Fog Text — Secondary muted text, captions, inactive controls; Reserved for button/dark accents

sand-label.$description: Sand Label — Mid-level text, metadata, helper copy, list labels — warm gray that holds presence without competing with primary text

spray-wash.$description: Spray Wash — Decorative highlight — the only chromatic accent in the system, used exclusively inside the teal-to-lime gradient banner

lightColor.$description: The light appearance's palette: Default's tokens (default.com, extracted by Refero 2026-07-03), a dark theme whose light end (snow, bone, chalk) and greys make the light roles, with iris as the accent

void.$description: Void — Deepest page canvas, terminal background, behind everything

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary card surface, panels, elevated containers, table rows

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary surface, borders, dividers, rail backgrounds

steel.$description: Steel — Muted body text, captions, helper text, dimmed labels

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary text, icon strokes, inactive nav items

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, placeholder text, disabled states

chalk.$description: Chalk — Body text secondary, table cell text

snow.$description: Snow — Primary headings, body text, icon fills, active states — the dominant ink at 413 occurrences

bone.$description: Bone — Primary action button fill — off-white pill against dark creates the highest-contrast CTA without introducing a chromatic brand color

ink.$description: Ink — Secondary body text, navigation labels, and subdued headings. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Brand accent — active nav indicators, link highlights, icon fills, active card borders. The one true chromatic color; used 21 times as fills, borders, and background tints

arc-blue.$description: Arc Blue — Light blue text accent, informational highlights, node icons in workflow diagrams

ring-blue.$description: Ring Blue — Focus rings, active card outline borders, selection state outlines at low alpha

mint.$description: Mint — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

fern.$description: Fern — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

coral.$description: Coral — Red text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

ember.$description: Ember — Decorative icon accent — orange chromatic chip in product mockups

iris.$description: Iris — Brand chip background tint in embedded mockups and product screenshots

stage.$description: EditorTheme.stage — window grounds: the editor's preview, the Library's grid, Settings

surface.$description: EditorTheme.surface — cards and floating panels: the capture toolbar, the Quick Access card

raised.$description: EditorTheme.raised — what floats over a surface: tooltips, the source picker, chosen tabs

control.$description: EditorTheme.control — controls' own fill: secondary buttons, tracks, chips, chosen tiles

hairline.$description: EditorTheme.hairline — lines between areas and around surfaces. Dark: white at 8%, a see-through ring as the web's box-shadow borders, in place of bistre border's black edge (picked 2026-10-09 against 6% and 12%)

ink.$description: EditorTheme.ink — text; at least 7:1 on every surface

dim.$description: EditorTheme.dim — values, notes and other secondary text; at least 4.5:1

faint.$description: EditorTheme.faint — structure marks only (ruler ticks, chevrons), never text; at least 3:1

accent.$description: EditorTheme.accent (the AccentColor asset, Color.accentColor) — lines, text and marks in the accent: playhead, selection, chosen tab, native controls' tint; at least 3:1. Spray wash in dark, iris in light

accentFill.$description: EditorTheme.accentFill — the accent as a fill (primary buttons, what is on), always with onAccent on it

onAccent.$description: EditorTheme.onAccent — text and icons on accentFill; at least 4.5:1 on it, 7:1 with Increase Contrast (page void on spray wash is 10:1, white on iris 6:1)

success.$description: EditorTheme.success — a status that is working, as an agent that is connected; at least 4.5:1 as text. Emerald (Tailwind's 400 in dark, 700 in light)

warning.$description: EditorTheme.warning — a status that needs the user, as an agent not connected or out of date; at least 4.5:1 as text. Ember (Tailwind's orange 400 in dark, 700 in light)

danger.$description: EditorTheme.danger — an action that takes something away, as Disconnect; at least 4.5:1 as text, on the control fill too. Rose (Tailwind's 400 in dark, 700 in light)

sans.$description: Typeface.sans — every label, title and control. Reco/Fonts/InterVariable.ttf (SIL OFL 1.1); a new family needs its font file there

mono.$description: Typeface.mono — shortcuts, file names, code. Reco/Fonts/JetBrainsMono.ttf (SIL OFL 1.1), in place of the paid Berkeley Mono
